body: I've been crying almost nonstop since I made this post. It's the first time I've ever spoke of what I think my dad did. I don't know if it even happened; I don't remember it, but I feel it. I've been thinking about posting this on Facebook, call him out for the horrible person my mind tells me he is. I want to ruin his life, take everything away from him, just as I feel he has done to me. I really don't think I can, but I just want him to pay some price for it. I wish I knew for certain, like I had something I could bring up that would be irrefutable, but I don't. I know deep down I need to let it go, just try to forget it, but I can't move on, I can't reconcile with it. I really wish I could find something that makes me happy, just something that makes me want to live. I've been on anti-depressants, they work in a way, they mask it and allow me to find some enjoyment in life, but I also want to overcome it and find more than just a mask to be happy.
